knowledge_graph.title: Mira Costa High School
knowledge_graph.type: Public high school in Manhattan Beach, California
knowledge_graph.description: Mira Costa High School is a four-year public high school located in Manhattan Beach, California, United States that first opened 1950. It is the only high school in the Manhattan Beach Unified School District. The school's athletic teams are known as the Mustangs and the school colors are green and gold.
